title: The early universe had a conscious experience at the end of inflation

statements.text: The early universe had a conscious experience at the end of inflation when its superposed registers underwent objective reduction, the early universe and the human mind share the same organization and quantum information, and consciousness may have a cosmic origin from the Planck time.

sources.quote: the early universe had a conscious experience at the end of inflation, when the superposed quantum state of n = 10 9 quantum gravity registers underwent Objective Reduction
